links.comparator_used: Other prompting strategies and other LLMs among the 16 models benchmarked, without a stepwise scaffold
links.outcome: Agreement between LLM-predicted and nurse-assigned ESI levels (quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa)
links.effect: Structured stepwise prompting reached kappa_qw = 0.747; other models ranged from 0.18 and mostly showed moderate or lower agreement
links.quote: Only a structured stepwise prompting strategy achieved substantial agreement (κ_qw = 0.747), approaching reported human inter-rater reliability.
